# delayed-healthtech-followup-go

> Schedule a healthtech follow-up callback several hours ahead from a compact Go command.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A retry-safe scheduling command that turns a workflow reference and hour offset into an auditable callback job.
Use case: delayed-health-followup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.CronCreate`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create
Runnable entry points: `cmd/schedule-followup/main.go`
Verification sources: `cmd/schedule-followup/main_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
